title: A BETTER way to find jobs on LinkedIn 🔎
description:
You may hear recruiters using the term "Boolean Search" when looking for candidates. But what does that actually mean? Boolean search terms are some of the essential tools a recruiter has at their disposa BUT you can use the same methods yourself to get better search results for jobs. By breaking your search up into terms and using “AND” or “OR” operators you can narrow your search for very specific results or broaden your search for a larger pool of jobs. #jobsearch #jobsearching #jobsearchtips #linkedin #linkedintips
